text: Can I have a really good snack?
Uh, I don’t know. I think it’s . . . uh . . . what time is it?
I think it’s going on dinner.
Three thirty. Uh . . . We’d better wait.
[Why, Dad?] Well, what kind of snack do you want?
No, candy is out. Oh, how about some broccoli?
[No!] Uh, carrots? [No!] Well, what else can you suggest?
Candy. No, I don’t think . . . I think You’d better wait.
Spinach sandwich? Spinach sandwich! When did you start liking spinach?
Well, what about a small sandwich?
[Okay] Okay, I’ll whip it up in a minute.
Play with your toys while you’re waiting for it.
